candidates.name: Khaki Short-Sleeve Mock-Neck Knit
candidates.decisionReason: The khaki knit has useful texture, but the product-only image provides no on-body shoulder, chest, length or drape proof and the washed beige color adds little Summer energy.

candidates.name: Green Short-Sleeve Mock-Neck Knit
candidates.decisionReason: The saturated green is welcome, but the isolated product render gives no credible body proof and its mock-neck tee construction reads basic rather than Formal Evening.

candidates.name: White Short-Sleeve Button-Up
candidates.decisionReason: The hanger image shows a crumpled casual band-collar overshirt layered over a crew tee, with rolled sleeves and a long rounded hem; it does not prove polished Formal shirting.

candidates.name: Light-Blue Ribbed Short-Sleeve Knit
candidates.decisionReason: The light blue and vertical rib are promising, but the cropped product view shows a narrow torso, visible bunching and a small hem badge while omitting full on-body proportion proof.

candidates.name: Lake-Blue Long-Sleeve Shirt
candidates.decisionReason: The hanger-only lake-blue shirt includes a novelty embroidered figure, white tee dependency, rolled cuffs and long overshirt styling; it reads casual and unproven rather than Formal.

candidates.name: Soft-Green Stripe Shirt
candidates.decisionReason: The soft green micro-stripe has credible regular ease, but the button-down collar, long untucked hem and lightweight daytime styling remain relaxed Office/Casual rather than Formal Evening.

candidates.name: Pale-Brown Relaxed Summer Shirt
candidates.decisionReason: The pale-brown shirt is worn open over a tee with a dropped shoulder, long body and visible backpack hardware, so it functions as a casual overshirt rather than evening shirting.

candidates.name: Khaki Regular Straight Trouser
candidates.decisionReason: The khaki trouser is clean but low-rise, narrow and conventionally office-like; it lacks the pleat, breathable texture and modern straight ease required for Summer Formal.

candidates.name: Light-Blue Straight Drawstring Trouser
candidates.decisionReason: The light-blue pant exposes an elastic drawstring waist, patch pockets, crumpled fabric, rolled hems and barefoot styling; it is clearly lounge or beach wear.

candidates.name: Flax-Coffee Lightweight Trouser
candidates.decisionReason: The flax-coffee trouser has a gathered waist, prominent black athletic drawcord and a long puddled hem over sneakers, making it casual and poorly proportioned for Formal Evening.

candidates.name: Light-Tan Straight Drawstring Trouser
candidates.decisionReason: The light-tan trouser has an exposed rope drawstring, broad lounge leg and fabric pooling over the shoes; the pale color cannot convert it into formal tailoring.

candidates.name: Light-Gray Relaxed Trouser
candidates.decisionReason: The isolated light-gray image omits rise, seat, full length and worn drape while the fabric looks smooth and technical; there is not enough proof for a Formal approval.

candidates.name: Gray Straight Drawstring Trouser
candidates.decisionReason: The gray trouser has a gathered elastic waist, visible drawstring, D-ring hardware and soft lounge construction, which directly conflicts with the requested tailored evening silhouette.
